svg.aria-label: The standard is authored as requirements, test cases, schemas with vectors, and definition bytes. Today the qualification tests check the schemas, vectors and definition bytes and report each vector admitted or refused. Compiler acceptance of the test cases by filament-spec-language and the backends is planned.
